overall_reason: The 'Project files' list scrolls itself upward one row at a time on an 800 ms transform with Tailwind's default curve, cut by a hard edge under the header that slices the top and bottom rows ('Wireframes.fig' and '182 KB' clipped at 2612 ms), and it is still moving at 5951 ms.

score.reason: T-CONTINUITY fails because a moving hard edge slices file names, T-LOOPS fails because the list moves on its own with nothing new to show, and T-MOTION-SYSTEM finds a framework default curve.

findings.where: passive recording, the file list under 'Project files', 1440
findings.evidence: At 2612 ms the clip edge under the header cuts through 'Wireframes.fig' and '182 KB', and the bottom edge cuts the next row to a line of dots; fold-1440.png shows the same slicing.
findings.before: A hard clip edge slices file names as the list scrolls.
findings.after: Fade rows at the list's top and bottom edges with a short mask, or move whole rows in and out with an opacity change so no text is cut (MOT-260).
findings.why: A sliced file name cannot be read, and the moving cut draws the eye to the edge instead of the files.

findings.where: passive recording, the self-scrolling file list, 1440
findings.evidence: The list moves from 'Brief.pdf' at the top (1609 ms) to 'Review.md' at the top (4011 ms) with no input, and the recorder reports it still moving at 5951 ms; the five files never change.
findings.before: The list scrolls on its own through the same five files.
findings.after: Show the files still, or move the list only when a file arrives, so the motion reports new data.
findings.why: An idle list that keeps moving pulls attention without telling the viewer anything new.

findings.evidence: The one declared transition is transform 800 ms on cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), which the motion table flags as Tailwind's default curve.
findings.before: A framework default curve on the only motion.
findings.after: Use the composition's own ease-out curve and a shorter step, about 300 to 400 ms per row.
findings.why: The default curve shows no decision behind the timing.

strengths: Each row keeps its name and size together as it moves, so a file is never split from its size.
not_investigated: anything moving on its own past 5 s with no pause control is WCAG 2.2.2 and belongs to lens-a11y
no click runs: the capture skipped click motion (--no-motion), so the sweep's MOT-002 measured limits are not verified and no trigger rows exist
the passive stills are 7 frames over 6 s (about 0, 400, 900, 1600, 2600, 4000 and 5500 ms); in-between frames, exact curves and the loop seam timing cannot be seen
interruptibility and rapid toggles (T-RAPID-TOGGLE): no detector built
hover as it plays, gestures, scroll-driven motion and route transitions: not captured
the 8 MOT-001 motion_css hits come from the shared stylesheet every item loads (.ss-bubble, .ss-receipt, .ss-roll__mid and others), not from this composition; they are left to the sweep
